spec: One 1px outline split into 4 to 12 cells by shared rules, no gaps, no radius. Each cell: 11px mono index, 15px/500 title, 14px muted copy, then a proof row pinned low showing a different tiny real artefact per cell. Optional + marks on junctions. Last cell tinted, closing with a link.

Three to six open columns, 24 to 32px gutters, no boxes. Each opens with a 1px top rule, or left rule with 32px inset, then 28px of space, a small icon or number, a 20 to 24px/400 title and 16 to 17px copy at 1.6. One line replaces the whole card.

Three or four columns with no boxes: 20 to 24px line icon, 16 to 20px title, 15 to 16px grey copy, aligned to the heading's left edge. Best with a bold run-in lead continuing into grey text. For six to twelve small capabilities, never the page's main feature section.

Four 270px columns on dashed vertical guides that run the full page through band changes. A 1px by 16px accent tick hangs on the guide beside each 15px/600 title, over a 40px duotone spot icon, 15/24 copy and inline 500-weight accent links. Needs guides across several sections.

Three to five columns with no icons. Hold one small device: a tracked accent code over a 36/46 heading, a first letter in the accent, or chips under each paragraph. 18/30 body. Hover can turn one cell into a surface. Needs specific copy, because nothing hides a vague sentence.

Three columns split by 1px rules at 8% ink, no cards. 11px mono figure label at 30% ink, one custom line drawing about 240 to 320px, 15px title, 15/24 muted copy. Faces filled with page colour so nearer planes hide farther lines, brightness falling downward. Needs real drawings.

Two or three hairline cells, each a 20px/600 column head over five to eight 18/34 rows with an 18px check. No icons, no blurbs. Reads as a contract you can count. Variant: a two-column grid of 150 by 38 outlined chips beside a statement card.

Three or four columns, 8 to 32px gaps. A plate 286 to 500px tall holding a real fragment or photo cropped by its edge, then 24px of space, a 20 to 28px/400 title and 16/1.4 copy at 58% ink on the bare page. No card, border or shadow behind the text.

Two to five candid photo cards about 421 by 500px, 16 to 24px gaps, radius 8 to 16. Translucent 11px caps pill top left, 24 to 28px title and one line with a bold lead at the foot, 40px white circle arrow. Scrim only in the lower half, 0.8 at base.

Two tiles per row, 8 to 16px gaps, near full bleed, little or no radius. Centred stack in the top third: 40/44 title, one line, pills or chevron links. Product fills the lower 55 to 60%, art-directed per tile, some cropped at the base. Pair a light tile with a dark one.

Borderless trays a tint 2 to 4% off the page, radius 12 to 16. Title and short copy on top, a different real UI fragment rising from the base, cropped or fading into the tray. Fragment changes per card, frame stays fixed. Rows may mix one full-width with two half-width.

Image, title and text inside one card: radius 8 to 24, 1px border or soft fill, media inset 16 to 20px with a slightly smaller radius, 20px title, 15px copy, link pinned to the base. Correct for articles, courses and resources. Prefer bare plates for product features.

Radius 8 to 16, 1px border at 8% ink, no fill, no shadow, 24px padding, 16 to 24px gap, 20px icon, 16 to 20px title. Good for link indexes and docs hubs where boxes signal a click. Change one thing, such as a pinned low title or a solid closing tile.

Borderless cards one step off the page, radius 8 to 40, gap 8 to 16. A 64px white icon tile, a claim, detail pushed low. Suits small claims on a tinted band. White cards on a saturated flood is the bold form. Avoid three equal cards with one sentence each.

Rows of two tiles in a 2:3 ratio, about 522 and 776px, swapping sides each row, radius 20, gap 24, tops offset 12px on purpose. A tint per tile, a demo filling the top 60 to 70%, then a 38 to 40px title and 19 to 20px copy.

Cards 304 to 400px wide at a 20 to 22px gap run past the right edge, the last cut by the viewport as the scroll cue. 36 to 40px round prev and next controls, disabled at 50%. For eight or more parallel items that need not all be read.

A table of contents: rows about 70px tall on 1px rules, a 44px light name left, a one-line description starting 62% across, no icons or cards. Hover shifts the row 12px and darkens the copy. For studios and services with five or more real items.

Short wide link tiles about 434 by 78px, 8 to 20px gaps, 24px label left, small illustration or product cutout and chevron right, under one plain question. Hover darkens the fill one step. Sorts visitors by need rather than feature. Good high on multi-audience pages.

One composed moment instead of a list: three hairline circles with captions in each lobe, a centred pitch between four corner cards, or columns stepping 32 to 216px lower. Use once per page, only when the content has that real structure, or the offset looks like a mistake.

Full-bleed tinted band or rounded panel: four columns of 36px line icon, 16px/600 title and 12 to 14px centred line. For shipping, returns, hours and amenities on stores and local businesses, low on the page. Keep it small, because it holds no argument.

A 440px copy column beside a 555 by 386px stage, radius 20 to 28, 1px inset hairline, tint changing per row. Layer two or three real fragments, one cut by the stage edge. 30/38 heading, 16/24 body at 60% ink, one text link. Rows may sit in alternating 590px bands.

One 1232px card per row, 6 to 18px radius, 1px hairline, rows 12px apart. Left: 22px title, 16px body, button pinned low. Right: 584px pane one tint off with layered UI cropped by the card. Keep copy on one side. A gradient hairline appears on the hovered row.

Two equal columns, plate 460 to 570px tall with a window cropped at its base, copy pinned to the plate's base line and the column above left empty. Two-tone heading, muted line then full ink, 16px at 56% ink. Next row flips 120px below. Needs visible page rails.

A 265 to 360px copy column beside an 830px window or photo that passes the container and runs off the viewport edge, saying there is more. Add four 70px-pitch icon rows for spec detail. Use once or twice for the most important product moment.

evidence.name: Medusa622: Luxury Skin & Nails in Knightsbridge

spec: Paired tiles 16px apart, radius 15, ratios changing per row, such as 778 and 582, then 545 and 817. Flat grey text tile, 25px padding, 32px heading, 17/29 body weighted low. Overlap rows by up to 180px for more movement. A zigzag with the stiffness removed.

Panels about 1312 by 670px, radius 30 to 40, gap 24 to 40, each a two or three stop pastel wash or flat flavour colour. A 48px heading with a small tag on one side, one floating UI card or tall photo on the other. Four panels at most.

Near viewport-tall 50/50 split, butted with no gap: full-bleed photo beside a flat field sampled from it. Small caps label, 26 to 32px title, 15/24 copy, thin outlined button. Change the colour per row. Print-like, for hospitality, architecture, food and institutions.

Consecutive 100vh sections, no dividers. A 430px text block sits in the empty part of each photo at a 100px margin, moving per shot: 48px heading, three lines of 16px, one ghost button. Needs at least three strong images. Flat colour scenes around one object also work.

Image 56 to 62% wide beside 320 to 420px text, about 100 to 130px between rows, sides swapping. Better when the 767px photo shifts sideways by 280px instead of fully swapping. Muted 15/21 body, 11px caps link with a 50px underline. Depends entirely on the photography.

A 369px copy column doing real work beside an 831px plate: heading, short copy, then three 46px plus-rows on hairlines, a two-column checklist with 24px filled circles, or four ruled spec rows, ending in stacked buttons. For rows with several facts.

Print-style size contrast: a 60px centred headline over a 212 by 286px portrait with 200px of white after it, or small photos scattered at different sizes beside a 52px heading. The image is far narrower than the type. For fashion, hospitality and magazines.

The reader does the demonstrating: a before and after slider with a draggable handle over one image, or a row of six 40px colour swatches that swap a name, story and buy button. Only worth it when the change is visible at a glance.

Three to six pills 38 to 56px tall, 8 to 16px gap, 16 to 28px above a window at real size. Active is solid ink, or a 1px ink outline on quiet pages. The window is taller than the section and cut by its bottom rule. Optional dimmed neighbour panels at 25%.

Indicator on a 1px rule above each label, filling as a 5 to 8 second timer; label never moves. Active full ink, others 50%. Pause on hover and focus, stop under reduced motion. Variants: ring timer in a corner, arc on the active row, foot segments on a slide.

A 628px stage, radius 20, beside a 518px accordion on 1px hairlines: 24px titles, 20/30 dark grey body, 24px circular chevrons, a 72px ink segment on the open row's top rule. Height animates via grid-template-rows. Fix the stage height. Best tab form for phones.

The list is the design: names 28 to 100px on 1px rules or none, active full ink, others 25 to 55%, a small preview swapping beside the list. A progress line can fill the active rule. For services and channels with good names, in agency and bold brand pages.

Three or four rows left, the active wrapped in a white 12px-radius card with a 1px border, others grey on the page, a live preview right. Or a 500px dark rail with a 2px white bar and blurb beside a chart. Compact, like an interface in the page.

14 to 18px labels, 24 to 40px gaps, on a full-width 1px rule, active indicator 2 to 4px. Sits directly on the window it controls. Placing the bar on top of the rule with the label below looks more considered than an underline. Scrolls sideways on phones.

A pale track pill about 56px tall with a solid active pill 6px inside, 17px labels, or a 404 by 46 rail with tracked mono caps. For two to five short options such as device or audience. Can pin under the nav while tiles scroll beneath.

Three tabs about 346 to 389px wide and 90 to 113px tall, radius 8 to 16, 1px border, 40px icon, 14 to 16px label, one description line. Active gets an accent border or thin glow on its bottom edge, 32px above a full dashboard.

Bordered 13 to 14px mono tabs on the top of the frame, active tab white with a 2px accent underline, content panel below holding a command or code. Honest for developer docs. Variants: square nodes on active corners, or flush filled cells about 226 by 46px.

One slide per view, 504 to 1140px wide, with the next peeking 36 to 40px away. Round arrows aligned to the heading, or a transport row with play ring and progress dashes that treats the carousel as media. For a few rich slides.

The control sits on a full-bleed image: three 42px pills bottom centre, active solid white, others with a 2px white outline, or a 14px list bottom left on a 30px rhythm with a small vertical tick. For products or card types.

Five tall panels about 300 by 400px bleeding off the right edge, photos duotoned to one hue so they match, 1px separators, a 40px circle plus top left, 20/500 white label at the foot. The active panel lifts its label 22px. For audiences or products.

The control is part of the idea: a heading written as a sentence with underlined variables and option lists either side of a stacked card deck, or hairlines running from each option into an illustration that fills to match. Use once, when the content has real structure.
Text or small pills, 13 to 18px, directly above a grid of cards, active in the accent, no underline, 28px gaps. Filters rather than swaps. For logos, customer stories and shop categories.

A 444 to 672px list beside a sticky 584 to 800px stage, three to five steps at about 72vh each. Scroll sets the active step, time plays the change. Active full ink, others 30%, plus one bar or rule. Stage must stay full. Plain flow without JavaScript.

A 218 to 348px sticky index beside a 1000px scrolling column, four to six chapters. 14 to 18px labels, active near-black with a 2px tick on the page rail. Each chapter is a run-in statement over a same-inset demo cell. Becomes a sticky horizontal row on phones.

A pinned screen with a fixed skeleton where only contents change across three to seven chapters: a 100vh film with a foot caption on the emptier side, a shared rule, a time rail of ticks, or a stage flooded per product beside an 88px icon rail.

Sheets about 1248 by 560px, radius 16, sticky at a top offset growing 14px per sheet so edges peek, shadow 0 30px 40px at 28% black. 72px left padding, 48px title, 20/30 copy, UI with a dark rail bleeding off the right. Three to six peers, block flow.

A 50/50 split: one half pins a panel or photo with copy at its foot while the other scrolls macro, model and detail shots, or rows on 1px rules that swap the pinned photo. Fill can step lighter per image. For one product or person with several images.

A 1px vertical line through the content with a marker tracking scroll: at page centre with copy left and UI right, or at page left with a 10px node per row turning into an accent ring. Inactive rows dim to 40%. Nothing pins, which keeps it light.

Type as the event, once per page: a pinned pale section where three 64px lines arrive from 8px blur and low opacity above three 70px step cards, or a 3D form inside a ring of 120 ticks filling with progress. For a positioning statement.

Vertical scroll drives panels sideways: a pinned heading over four 110px segment bars filling with progress, while photo and bullet panels slide in from the right over a dot grid. For parallel items rather than ordered steps.

A rounded card holding a headline and screenshot scales up until it fills the viewport as you scroll. One per page, as an entrance to something important. A plain scale without a crop change looks like a zoom bug.

Three or four columns, each a small marker, a 32px tight title, 18/29 copy, then the real screen at full size with no window chrome: a picker, a form, a feed. Reserve copy height so the proofs start level. The first thing to try for any product.

A centred 720px column of 28px solid ink circles with 13px numerals joined by a 1px line, 24px/400 titles indented 56px, 17/27 body, 150px pitch. Needs no art, so it suits services and local businesses. The line stops at the last dot.

Three to five centred columns on a 1px line running dot centre to dot centre: 16px hollow dots, current one solid, 11px mono index, 16px/600 title, 14px caption. Clicking a stop can swap a panel below, so it doubles as tabs. For lifecycles, APIs and finance.

Rows about 140px apart on 1px rules beside a sticky heading: 14px mono numeral, 24px title, 16px line, small link with a long arrow. Or numerals hung in the margin so alignment is the only ornament. For short, numerous steps.

Three to five columns split or topped by 1px rules, 28px inner padding, 12 to 13px label, 20 to 24px step name, 16/25 copy. One signature: a giant letter per column spelling the method, 64px outlined numerals, or a meter filling by thirds. For agency and B2B process.

A stepper: a 56px numeral beside a 560px white card, others collapsed and grey, opposite one coloured tile or floating UI card that changes per step, with progress dots. Can autoplay. For when one phone or card can show each stage.

The route becomes the picture: a sine path drawn on scroll with stops and a floating detail card, role cards seated on a thick ring, or light travelling an open outline. Use only when the process has a real shape and you have strong drawings.

Three cards about 330 to 390px, rotated plus or minus 3 to 5 degrees, slightly overlapping, soft 40px shadow, hand-drawn arrows between. Number and title on top, copy pinned low. Human and handmade, for freelancers and small brands. Once per page.

For developers, steps are code: a bracketed mono number, 16px/600 title and 16/28 prose beside a 545px code card aligned at the top, or three 328px panes showing a transformation. The layout itself explains the process.

One step per viewport: a numeral of about 300px with a 1px metallic stroke and faint fill tucked behind a 640px phone, copy low and right at 24px with 18px grey. For a slow premium story of three steps.

When steps are days: three rows split by 1px rules, a 24px light date with a small chip in the first column, a bare 16/24 list in the second. Or centred date and description pairs with no rails. For events, courses and launches.
Steps as coloured sheets, radius 16, overlapping upward on scroll beside a sticky heading, 36px titles with numbers and 18px body. Reuse the sticky stacked-sheets recipe. Three to five steps.

Three or four equal cards each with a number, a title and a line. The template, and the lowest-scoring steps form. Use only when steps are trivial on a small local page. Prefer a vertical numbered rail, which needs no art and looks considered.

evidence.name: Brand Designer for B2B SaaS, Fintech & Tech Startups
